TRIGGERED_ABILITY.INTERVENING_IF:
local triggerObject = TriggerObjectLKI() local effectSource = EffectSource() if triggerObject ~= nil and effectSource ~= nil then local triggerPower = triggerObject:GetCurrentCharacteristics():Power_Get() local triggerToughness = triggerObject:GetCurrentCharacteristics():Toughness_Get()
local effectPower = effectSource:GetCurrentCharacteristics():Power_Get() local effectToughness = effectSource:GetCurrentCharacteristics():Toughness_Get() if (triggerPower > effectPower) or (triggerToughness > effectToughness) then return true end end return false
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: if EffectSource() ~= nil then local numCountersAdded = EffectSource():AddCounters( MTG():PlusOnePlusOneCounters(), 1) EffectDC():Set_Int(0,numCountersAdded) end
local countersAdded = EffectDC():Get_Int(0) if countersAdded >0 then MTG():FireTrigger( TRIGGER_EVOLVED, EffectSource() ) end
